scope:
Package K2b-1 (KERNEL ACTIONS, second third of M1-K2; no ChatEngine::send branch yet, no web): the interview of the person ('Ty') becomes reachable through the same actions as everything else (loom_invoke / POST /api/actions/... / the action catalogue), over the EXISTING durable store. Source of truth: docs/architecture/M1_USTAWIENIA_JAKO_GRAF_2026-10-16.md item '### M1-K2' (line ~331; read that item only, the part about loom/src/actions/ops.cpp + actions.pack: profile.interview {op: start|answer|review|skip|never|status, conv_id?}, profile.show, profile.set {slot, value} with confirm:profile.set) and docs/reports/INDEX.md 'S1 / M1-K2a' + 'S1 / M1-K2a-fix' (what K2a built: questions(locale), levels(), plan({level, by_category}), apply_remark(text, locale, options) returning PROPOSALS; slot_labels). Branch claude/m1-w0 is at 5b0e04ff or later (K2a + K2a-fix + FLAKE-1 + S2's driver). The owner's rules that apply: nothing is decided for the person; every limit is a configurable preset; 'declined' is never asked again, 'never' is respected until the person reopens it; no private data leaves the machine from this package (no model call at all here: FORM MODE only; the model path stays denied/unknown with a reason, it is K2b-2 and needs privacy_decision + a cost estimate); his lists are examples; nothing is hidden silently.
EXISTING (checked): loom/include/loom/onboarding_store.h OnboardingStore(Database&): open(user, legacy), read(user), apply(user, expected_revision, action) [target profile|layers|model_reply; ops answer, propose, review, status, delete, settings, privacy, pause, resume, skip, repeat, confirm_section; outer `revision` is the optimistic-concurrency token, the inner profile revision is distinct], model_request, policy_decision; loom/src/onboarding/README.md explains lifecycle; ProfileSession (loom/include/loom/onboarding.h, profile.cpp) with K2a's questions/levels/plan/apply_remark; the HTTP onboarding UI routes already exist (loom/server/src/onboarding-ui-routes.h) and the web controller (loom/web/src/onboarding/) - READ how they call the store before inventing a second path, reuse their semantics (user id, revision handling, error shapes). The action layer: loom/src/actions/ops.cpp (StepOutcome ops, e.g. graph_navigate / context_modify as models: Ctx x, x.say(pack key, args) for words, fail(Errc, text)), loom/data/runtime/actions.pack (catalogue entries with params and pl/en descriptions), chat_ops.pack/phrases for words (pl+en data, no literals in C++), loom/src/actions/runner.cpp (routing of the confirm gate: actions that write the person's profile ask first via the existing confirm mechanism - find how settings.set / rules.set do it and use the SAME mechanism for profile.set).
BUILD, commit after each: (1) profile.show {locale?}: the slots with state (unknown|known|declined|never), value only for known, provenance (user_stated|form|model_inferred|import|...), the chosen level and the plan summary (how many questions remain at this level, the reasons for skipped ones from plan()), in words from the pack; reads only; never returns a value of a 'never' slot. A slot above the chosen level is reported with the reason 'above_level' (K2a-fix noted the Ty screen shows such slots as 'nieznane' although they will never be asked - make the state honest: add an additive field `asked_at_level: false` and the reason, do not change existing field names). (2) profile.interview {op}: start (opens the store, returns the FIRST question = the level question 'how many questions' with the three level previews, in the requested locale), answer {slot, text} (user_stated, goes through apply with expected_revision handling; an answer text is FIRST checked with apply_remark: a matching remark returns its PROPOSALS ('Tak zrozumialem ...' lines, nothing written) and asks the person to confirm through the existing confirmation mechanism before it applies them; no match = stores the answer), the level answer stores profile_detail_level through the existing setting path (not a hard-coded constant) and returns the next question from plan(), review (the candidate summary of the section as an ACTION PROPOSAL the person confirms - reuse ActionProposalBlock / the proposal shape used by agent.run proposals), skip (stores 'skipped' for this session only), never {slot|category} (status never, same semantics as the person's own never), status (progress: asked/answered/remaining at this level, the paused/skipped state). Every op returns the NEXT question or the end-of-section card as words, never prompts a model, and says in words when it did not do something and why. (3) profile.set {slot, value} with the confirmation gate (confirm:profile.set), provenance user_stated, honours 'never' (refuses with the reopen hint) and records history the way the store does. (4) CATALOGUE + WORDS: actions.pack entries for profile.interview, profile.show, profile.set (params, kinds, pl+en descriptions, which ones are read-only: show), phrases pl+en in the pack the neighbours use; regenerate runtime_profiles_embedded.inc (python3 loom/src/model/gen_runtime_profiles.py, then --check); route literals: the HTTP facade derives routes from actions.pack - if new web API route literals appear in loom/web/src/api/*.ts or the facade, run the registry chain (python3 loom/tools/gen_graph_interfaces.py -> gen_runtime_profiles.py (then --check) -> re-pin sha256 of graph/interfaces.pack in loom/data/data_domains.pack -> ctest -R 'graph_entry|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|runtime_profile|onboarding_pack|graph_proj'); chat_coverage / action coverage tests (M1-T1 'chat_coverage dla wszystkich nowych akcji'): add the three actions to whatever coverage list exists (grep chat_coverage.pack) with their example phrases pl+en or the test will tell you. (5) TESTS (doctest, loom/tests/, new test_profile_ops.cpp or extend test_onboarding_interview.cpp; mock nothing that needs a model): start -> level question; answer level 'minimal' -> next question is one of the 2 minimal fields; answer with remark 'nie pytaj o zdrowie' -> proposals returned, nothing written until confirmed, after confirm the category is 'never' and plan() no longer lists it; declined/never survive a second interview; profile.show never leaks a never/unknown value and reports above_level; profile.set asks first, refuses never; revision conflict is reported, not swallowed; privacy: no network is touched (the test fails if an HTTP transport is called - use the existing fake transport counters); ASAN pitfall rules. The actions must be exercised through loom_invoke (the C ABI path) at least once so the exception firewall and JSON shape are covered; test_abi_compat unchanged.
DECISIONS ARE YOURS (R1-R53): record each with how to reverse under 'S1 / M1-K2b1' in docs/reports/INDEX.md. Do NOT touch loom/android/smoke/*, loom/web (next: W2), loom/src/chat/chat_engine.cpp (K2b-2), the golden chat_request_legacy.json, the receipt schema. If after about 60 tool calls a piece is unfinished, commit what is consistent and return done=false with exactly what is left.
accept: cmake --build --preset dev (background, polled) succeeds; ctest --preset dev -R 'onboarding|profile|party|actions|chat_coverage|runtime_profile|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|graph_entry|abi_compat|compat' green; gen_runtime_profiles.py --check clean; gen_onboarding_pack.py --check clean if you touched scenario.pack; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev all ok; python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/lint_asan_range_for.py 5b0e04ff shows 0 suspicious lines; pushed to origin claude/m1-w0. The card pastes: one JSON/answer of each op (start, answer with level, answer with a remark, review, never, status, show, set) in pl, the confirmation flow in words, the above_level field, what you reused from the existing HTTP onboarding routes, and exactly what is left for K2b-2 (ChatEngine branch) and for W2 (web).
rules_extra: Shared machine: never kill processes by name; record the pid/port you started. Do NOT run the full gate (S1 does). CACHE RULE: no single tool call longer than ~4 minutes - run builds and tests in the background and poll with short calls. One native build at a time (loom/build/dev of this worktree). Keep context small: grep and line ranges, never dump big files. ASAN pitfall: never range-for over .at()/.value()/operator[] of a by-value temporary - bind to a named const first. Generated *.inc data keeps explicit lengths. Tests must not depend on speed or order. Private data: synthetic data only; never read docs/exports or eval/real-holdout-key. Texts for the owner in plain Polish and English; nothing described as working that is only planned.
